text.tspan: Q42–Q43 · Postgres on EC2 → RDS with near-zero downtime
Limits: sequences and schema changes aren't replicated; UPDATE/DELETE need a primary key. Or AWS DMS (full load + CDC).
Why not dual writes? No transaction spans two databases → silent divergence, and app changes.
RDS can't be a physical replica of an external primary, so it's logical replication.
